bromsgrove-26-00744-FUL.dev: Two detached four-bedroom dwellings with access and landscaping on a 0.15 ha treed plot
bromsgrove-26-00744-FUL.ins: Ruth Bamford (Assistant Director, Planning, Leisure and Culture)
kf: Decision notice dated 17 Aug 2026, the Framework's day of effect, and assessed entirely under the December 2024 Framework
Supply 2.24 years at April 2025
The site is outside the Fairfield settlement boundary but, per appeal APP/P1805/W/21/3279054 (Feb 2022), "lies within the village of Fairfield" on the ground
Ten neighbour objections (Green Belt precedent, narrow lane, gap between Bournheath and Fairfield); no parish response
A 2013 application for one dwelling on the site was refused
n: assessed as 2024 ¶155 (a) to (d). Grey belt with (a) moderate, (b) weak, (d) none; unmet need (2.24-year supply); sustainable, relying on a 2022 appeal finding that the site is within Fairfield village and about 400 m (5 minutes' walk) from facilities
decision dated 17 Aug 2026, the day the new Framework took effect, but the notice lists "National Planning Policy Framework (2024)" and applies ¶11(d), ¶143, ¶154, ¶155 and footnote 7
